# authwise_provider_oauth (Data Source)

OAuth 2.0 with no id_token: explicit endpoints, a userinfo document, and a claim map over it (`userinfo.<path>` sources). X, Discord, Amazon, Twitch, Spotify and Bitbucket are recipes on this type. Builds a ProviderOAuth config and exposes its google.protobuf.Any encoding as `any`. Makes no API calls.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claim_map` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claim_map))
- `identifier_source` (String)

### Optional

- `authorization_params` (Map of String)
- `authorization_url` (String)
- `client_auth_method` (String)
- `client_id` (String)
- `client_secret_ref` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--client_secret_ref))
- `pkce` (String)
- `scopes` (List of String)
- `token_url` (String)
- `userinfo_url` (String)

### Read-Only

- `any` (String) protojson-encoded google.protobuf.Any (includes `@type`); reference this from Any-typed resource attributes.
